scope: Executed portable global overview ingestion, source-backed population allocation/continuity and coarse terrain sampling only

commands.command: python3 tools/geography/global_layers.py reproduce && python3 tools/geography/global_terrain.py reproduce

terrain.coverage: complete global grid, including poles and ocean bathymetry

grid.ordering: south-to-north rows, west-to-east columns, little-endian int16
grid.source_description: Reduced by Gaussian Cartesian filtering (31.5 km fullwidth) from GEBCO_2025.nc [GEBCO Bathymetric Compilation Group, 2025 GEBCO 2025 Grid; https://doi.org/10.5285/37c52e96-24ea-67ce-e063-7086abc05f29]
grid.source_title: GEBCO Earth Relief 2025 at 06 arc minutes

terrain.height_datum: mean sea level approximation; source mixes heterogeneous datums; not WGS84 ellipsoidal height
limitations: 6 arcminute (~11 km latitude spacing) overview with Gaussian smoothing; no road-level or building-level accuracy.
Sea-floor elevation is not water-surface elevation. Never use for navigation or safety at sea.
Sampling interpolates the overview; it does not invent higher resolution. Geoid conversion is not included.

source.citation: GEBCO Compilation Group (2025), GEBCO 2025 Grid, doi:10.5285/37c52e96-24ea-67ce-e063-7086abc05f29; Gaussian-filtered 6 arcminute derivative by GMT.
source.license: Public domain; source acknowledgment and non-misrepresentation terms

negative_evidence: evidence/geography/global-acquisition-initial.log records initial refusal of empty ISO codes on distinct aggregate rows; fixed by retaining their distinct aggregate IDs while excluding aggregates from economy sums.
evidence/geography/global-tests-initial.log records an incorrect >20000 test expectation; source-derived actual geometry part count is 19054 and the assertion now pins the observed source count.
remaining: Global street/building/land-use and routable rail/maritime partitions.
